script_text: The cosmos is lighting a fire under your routines this week, Sagittarius. Early on, Monday through Wednesday, your ruling planet Jupiter sextiles Mercury in your 9th House, sharpening your voice for career pitches while Venus in your 7th House trines Mars, sparking passionate love conversations by Tuesday. Mid-week, the Sun squares Saturn in your 2nd House on Thursday, forcing a hard look at money limits and slowing spending. Late week, Jupiter enters your 10th House Friday, boosting professional recognition through Sunday as the Moon conjuncts Neptune in your 4th House softening home vibes. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Mars igniting romance. Saturday is your worst day because Sun square Saturn strains your budget. Negotiate a raise under Jupiter’s career glow and text your crush Tuesday. Follow for daily updates.
